messages:
maya: Quick async check — optimize toolkit quant recs are in staging for a dry run. I pushed a small PR with profile mappings + batch/caching knobs. Need: owner for canary, someone to run a smoke pass on inference latency, and a quick review on the PR.

eli: typo question — are we applying 4-bit quant to all t5 variants or only the medium/large?

maya: only medium+ (t5-m, t5-l). tiny/mini keep fp16 for now. rationale in PR.

jack: FYI eng-platform: routing policy change needed for canary (prefer _low-latency_ pool). @sophia can you confirm we have capacity? Also listing dependent item: model-variant optimizer needs the new quant kernels from runtime team.

sophia: I can own canary monitoring and regression alerts. I'll wire the eval hooks to the console; sending quick test plan now. If regressions >2% on quality eval set we pause canary.

maya: thanks @sophia. PR: https://git.redwood.company/r/optkit/quant-profiles/pulls/42 — small config, instructions in the description. Please comment if you need additional perf traces.

eli: quick smoke command I used:
```
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood/api/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"t5-m-quant4","input":"Summarize: ...","max_tokens":64}'
```
latency ~120ms with batching disabled.

jack: note — eng-runtime needs to ship kernel patch v2.3.1 for the quant4 path. @runtime-team can we get that staged today? deploy-bot: any planned deploy windows?

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout window: 2107774500 — will mark as 'staging-only' unless manual promote :rocket: 

qa-bot: regression-alert: eval-suite/optkit-base — prompt_set_12 saw quality drop +3.1% on rouge. Details: https://ci.redwood.company/reports/optkit/2107773333

sophia: seeing the QA alert. I'll run selective eval on the failing prompts and attach diffs. If degraded, we'll revert quant for that variant and roll with fp16 for now.

maya: plan: (1) runtime patch staged by eng-runtime, (2) canary owned by @sophia, (3) eng-platform to confirm routing config, (4) roll forward only if regressions <=2%. Anyone else owning the PR review? cc @eli @jack

eli: I'll take the PR review, will finish in the next hour.

jack: I'll coordinate the routing change and confirm capacity. ping me if the runtime patch slips.

sophia: starting evals now, will post results in this thread. :mag:

maya: great — thanks. tagging milestone: optimize-toolkit/dryrun-210777 for tracking. will update the console ticket once canary is green.
